talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 29 solo PCPs winding down in Indiana; 3 ZIP(s) have 2+ at once (Merrillville 46410, East Chicago 46312, Richmond 47374) — each a ~12-month drive-time compliance gap.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~4,208 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.
**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (Parke County, DeKalb County) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 9 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~100,800 patients across 84 at-risk practices statewide.
